title: Sum of Two Numbers
description: Read two integers and print their sum.
output_format: Print one integer: the sum of the two numbers.

starter_code.Python:
first, second = map(int, input().split())
print(first + second)

learning_content.title: Input, variables and arithmetic
learning_content.intro: Read two integers into variables, add them and print the result. This exercise introduces standard input, variable assignment and arithmetic expressions.
learning_content.note: A fixed number of operations is performed.

quiz.question: What is the sum of -4 and 7?

options.feedback: Adding magnitudes and keeping the negative sign would be incorrect.
Seven minus four equals three, and the positive value has the larger magnitude.
Adding absolute values ignores the negative sign of -4.
